description: This file defines data structures and enums for statistical measurements within the gmeasure package, including Stat and StatsType enums, and the Stats struct with methods for statistical data representation and formatting.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: Represents statistical data for measurements, including type, experiment and measurement names, units, style, precision, data points count, value and duration bundles, and annotations.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a minimal summary string of the statistics, including min, median, mean, std deviation, and max.

methods.name: ValueFor
methods.description: Returns the float64 value for a specific Stat when StatsType is value-based.

methods.name: DurationFor
methods.description: Returns the time.Duration for a specific Stat when StatsType is duration-based.

methods.name: FloatFor
methods.description: Returns a float64 representation of a Stat, converting duration to float64 if needed.

methods.name: StringFor
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of a specific Stat, respecting the precision bundle.

methods.name: cells
methods.description: Generates a slice of table cells representing the statistical data, including annotations.
